description: Low-level lookup for a public Hugging Face LoRA link. Prefer hydracept_suggest_lora, which also matches project aliases and returns a generation patch or a confirmation. Returns the pinned commit, weight files, detected base-model family, suggested name, strength, and trigger words. Does not register an adapter, download weight tensors, or spend money. A detected family with executable=false can be saved but current image routes cannot run it.
name: hydracept_preview_lora_source
title: Preview LoRA source
